_note: Per-repo inputs for the SV Way compliance checker (canonical copy: Stadium-Ventures/sv-registry scripts/compliance/sv-way-check.cjs). Authored 2026-07-29 (WP1 role-declaration pass); values established by reading this repo's files, not inference. Corrected 2026-09-28 (roster cutover: upstream now switchable via ROSTER_SOURCE).
_roles_why: Per CLAUDE.md and sv-app.json: fetch_and_build.py parses TeamIntel Slack messages into a static dashboard. public/index.html and public/teamintel.json are generated projections committed each build (direct edits are wiped) — surface. The repo homes two kinds of source data: (1) the hand-curated yearly inputs in data/ (front_office_2026.csv, team_draft_2026.csv, farm_system_2026.csv, recommended_schedule_2026.json) which exist nowhere else, and (2) user edits held in Upstash Redis (score_overrides / manual_records / calendar_events) written only through the three Vercel serverless functions in api/ and merged into outputs on the next build.
canon_trees: Upstash Redis keys: score_overrides, manual_records, calendar_events
write_door: api/overrides.js + api/manual-records.js + api/calendar-events.js (sole write path for the Redis-held edit data); data/*.csv|json are hand-edited per draft cycle with no governed writer

upstream.mechanism: Switchable (roster_source.py, repo variable ROSTER_SOURCE). Default `hardcoded`: the per-cycle dicts in fetch_and_build.py (PLAYERS_2026 / CHANNEL_TO_PLAYER / CHANNELS), NOT resolved against sv-registry; with SV_REGISTRY_ROSTER_TOKEN set the build logs a [dual-run] comparison only. `registry`: the DRAFT_YEAR draft class from GET https://sv-registry.vercel.app/api/roster-projection (read:roster-projection platform-secret token, fails closed). Declared in sv-registry data/reference/roster-projection-consumers.json.

_open_questions: Read-duty gap (closing): the roster is hand-maintained in fetch_and_build.py until ROSTER_SOURCE=registry is set; the switch and the dual-run log exist. Open: whether the tracked set is the whole draft class (draft_class == DRAFT_YEAR) or narrower — a human ruling before the flip.
Downstream: public/teamintel.json is consumed by sv-draft-fit via manual copy (per sv-app.json knownIssues) — the projection handoff is not automated.
Whether the Redis-held manual TeamIntel records should eventually actualize into sv-registry (they are firm work about players) is undecided.
